See also: comprenderé

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin comprendere, variant of comprehendere.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /komˈprɛn.de.re/
  • Rhymes: -ɛndere
  • Hyphenation: com‧prèn‧de‧re

Verb

[edit]

comprèndere (first-person singular present comprèndo, first-person singular past historic comprési, past participle compréso, auxiliary avére)

  1. (transitive) to comprise, to include, to encompass
  2. (transitive) to understand, comprehend, take the point, get the point
    Synonyms: capire, intendere
